Create a conference trip planner for me as a Claw Me Page. Include choose fewer sessions, keep logistics together, after the trip. Ask only for missing information in one concise batch: confirmed dates and bookings, venue, learning goals, session choices, access needs and follow-up plan.

Use the Claw Me source at https://github.com/clawdotme/plugin in templates/conference-trip-planner/index.html and templates/_shared/tailwind/README.md. Use semantic responsive HTML, working section links, and useful native details/summary interactions. No scripts, forms, tracking, or embedded frames in the static Page. Deliver matching HTML and PDF from the same content, expand disclosures for print, and inspect page breaks. Use a readable portrait PDF. Keep the result private for review; do not send messages, connect services, purchase anything, or change sharing without my instruction. PDF export is separate from Page publishing unless the current platform explicitly supports it.

exampleAnswers.Purpose and audience: Plan a conference trip around confirmed logistics, selected sessions, and follow-up time.
exampleAnswers.Working context: This fictional two-day conference trip is a planning example, not a current travel recommendation. Replace transport, venue, and accommodation details with verified bookings before relying on the plan.
exampleAnswers.Example records:
When: Day one · morning · Plan: Travel and venue arrival · Preparation: Confirm route and ticket
When: Day one · afternoon · Plan: Two selected sessions · Preparation: Write one question per session
When: Day two · morning · Plan: Peer conversations · Preparation: Keep space between meetings
When: Day two · afternoon · Plan: Return and notes · Preparation: Record three follow-up actions
exampleAnswers.Content decisions:
Choose fewer sessions: Select the sessions that support a real learning question. Leave time to compare notes and meet people instead of treating every timetable gap as an obligation.
Keep logistics together: Record booking references only in the private version. Include venue access information, local time, transport alternatives, and a contact for travel changes after verifying each detail.
After the trip: Write the useful findings while they are fresh. Separate ideas worth testing from contacts to follow up with, and review any message before sending it.
exampleAnswers.Format and interaction: schedule layout; section navigation and expandable detail where useful; matching portrait document PDF.
exampleAnswers.Sharing and provenance: A hypothetical example informed by Claw Me’s small-team and Agent workflows. These are not Pete’s actual clients, finances, travel plans, research results, or commitments. Keep the real adaptation private until the owner chooses to share.
